issues.title: KTO live requests can be rate limited
issues.evidence: After KTO_SERVICE_KEY was overwritten from local GOAT.env and production was redeployed, the live KTO proxy returned HTTP 429. Existing selected KTO image delivery still returned 200 image/jpg.
issues.impact: Live refresh may use verified curated or Google fallback data; it is not classified as NO_ASSET.
issues.requiredAction: Monitor quota and backoff behavior; do not reclassify 429 as missing content.
